triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: his warm sympathy for his unhappy brother was unmistakable.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: That’s right, Alyosha, it was the little bag I struck with my fist.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: through his passion for Grushenka and his rivalry with his father, his brother had been of late in an intolerable position.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: As for the rivalry of the two “ladies,” as the prosecutor expressed it—that is, of Grushenka and Katya—he answered evasively

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Katerina Ivanovna replied firmly that she had been formerly betrothed to the prisoner

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: which he might have returned to Katerina Ivanovna as half of what he owed her

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: pointing to the fifteen hundred roubles which were on his breast, just below the neck

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: I was once indebted to him for assistance in money for more than three thousand, and I took it, although I could not at that time foresee that I should ever be in a position to repay my debt.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: I knew he had a feud with his father and have always believed that he had been unfairly treated by his father.

triples.subject: Mikhail Rakitin
triples.quote: Why, he is my cousin. His mother was my mother’s sister. But he’s always besought me not to tell any one here of it, he is so dreadfully ashamed of me.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: The woman who came between us has ruined him; she is the cause of it all, let me tell you,” Grushenka added.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: When the prisoner was arrested at Mokroe,” the prosecutor asked, “every one saw and heard you run out of the next room and cry out: ‘It’s all my fault. We’ll go to Siberia together!’
